A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Variational Search Distributions with the same authors, method, and experiments. Text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices support comparison; renamed and renumbered material can be matched.

before.justification: V3 reports original VSD evaluations on MNIST, biological sequence tasks, and Ehrlich functions, including comparative results, diversity analyses, and ablations.

after.justification: V4 retains these original experimental results in Section 4 and Appendix D.

M1.justification: The variational objective, classifier loss, gradient estimator, architectures, and Algorithm 1 procedure remain unchanged. The CPE-PI terminology and explicit classifier-based gradient equation clarify the existing method; the revised regularization analysis does not establish an implementation change.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate MNIST, DHFR, TrpB, TFBIND8, AAV, GFP, and the POLI and HOLO Ehrlich implementations with the same sequence lengths and tasks. The new explanatory diagram introduces no evaluated scenario.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain Random, DbAS, CbAS, BORE/BOPR, AdaLead, and PEX, and the Ehrlich comparisons retain GA, CbAS, and LaMBO-2. Revised feature annotations in Table 2 do not change evaluated comparator membership.

E3.justification: Initial training data, thresholds, batch sizes, round counts, optimization budgets, network configurations, cross-validation, and evaluation metrics are retained. V4 newly identifies Adam without reporting a replacement of an earlier optimizer.

E4.justification: V3 Appendix C matches v4 Appendix D: the GP-PI comparison, diversity analyses, and prior/variational-family ablations retain the same questions, configurations, and evidence. The new workflow illustration is explanatory rather than an additional analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions report five random initialization seeds and retain identical experimental error bars and bands. V4 adds no run-count information, uncertainty-estimation procedure, or significance testing.

E6.justification: Main Figures 2–5 and the appendix results—v3 Figures 7–12 corresponding to v4 Figures D.3–D.8—contain identical experimental images and plots. Reported numerical scores and substantive experimental findings are retained.

T1.justification: V3 Appendix E's scalar ridge regularization model is replaced in v4 Appendix F by an early-stopping-dependent regularization matrix. V4 adds Lemma F.1, substantially expands variance and estimation-error proofs, strengthens the kernel assumption, and introduces learning-rate Assumption F.6. It also corrects the stochastic-order definition and explicitly qualifies Corollary 2.2 by the infinite-width limit, while retaining the headline convergence rates.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: active generation, a variational solution, convergence guarantees, and competitive empirical performance. Describing the objective as conditioning a generative model clarifies a purpose already explicit in v3.

C2.justification: New Appendix B explains how generation avoids candidate enumeration and supports larger batches than unmodified batch BO. Appendix F qualifies the suggested extension to changing thresholds by requiring a convergent threshold sequence, replacing v3's unspecified 'minor adjustments.' Statements about mean-field suitability also become more cautious.

D1.justification: V4 adds a code-and-experiments repository link in the conclusion and explicitly identifies Adam in the experimental details. These improve access instructions and implementation disclosure; the other configurations and training details are retained.

R1.justification: V4 adds focused references for Adam, estimation-of-distribution algorithms, batch BO, and the expanded proofs, while removing Hu et al. (2020) and Shawe-Taylor and Cristianini (2004). Appendix B elaborates the batch-BO comparison, and Table 2 changes DbAS/CbAS sequential support from full to partial.

P1.justification: The abstract, problem statement, and conclusion receive localized rewrites; CPE-PI terminology, explanatory Appendix B, and acknowledgments are added. Appendices are relettered, and the acronym glossary disappears while its heading remains. The overall main-text organization is retained.

P2.justification: Figure 1 removes its final panel and enlarges the remaining panels. V4 adds workflow Figure B.1 and expands Table 1's sampling labels. Appendix numbering and float placement change, but experimental plots retain their content, arrangement, and displayed sizes.

improvement.justification: V4 improves explanation and reproducibility information, but its replacement of v3's scalar-ridge argument introduces unresolved proof inconsistencies. Equation 91 defines regularization using exp(+νsK), whereas Lemma F.1 and Equation 96 use exp(−νsK); Equation 111 also changes factors of ρ across purported equalities. These issues prevent treating the expanded theory as a demonstrated improvement. With unchanged empirical evidence, the net effect of clearer exposition versus problems in the revised theoretical support remains uncertain.
